import json
d=json.load(open('/home/user/Deepresearch.se/public/introspect/docs-corpus.json'))
s=json.dumps(d)
import re
hits=[m for m in re.finditer(r'src/prompts\.js#L(\d+)', s)]
print('prompts.js symbol refs in docs corpus:', len(hits), [h.group(0) for h in hits][:10])
